title: Resolution urging Albany to cap homeowners' insurance rate hikes
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.6356/A.4188, which would prohibit homeowners' insurance rate increases of more than 25 percent per year except when agreed to in the policy. It cites that New York homeowners have seen average premium increases of over $1,000 since 2020 and that nearly half a million homeowners are completely uninsured.
